title: Complete Board Workbench UI
description: Complete the board UI in elements/client/lib/board/play. Expand selection and details editing to all graph kinds, including node kinds, edge kinds, wire kinds, and handles. Add a proper workbench right panel with three tabs: Graph (Nodes with child handles subtree items, Edges), Kinds (Node kinds, Edge kinds, Wire kinds), Constraints (compatibility names with specificity, using -- for bidirectional and -> for directed). Make all relevant information editable in the details panel, including dropdowns to switch kinds. Add context menus for selection-aware actions like hide, lock, and delete depending on the current selection/background. Keep changes in existing files and use the existing board play/editor surface.
summary: Completed the board play workbench UI in elements/client/lib/board/play with a dedicated Workbench panel (Graph, Kinds, Constraints), expanded details editing for nodes, handles, edges, wires, kind rows, and compatibility constraints, and selection-aware context menus for background and graph objects. Extended board fixture edge parsing to keep edgeKind values and updated board canvas target menus to include wires. Validated with bun ./script.ts test in elements/client/lib/board: Rust tests passed, Vitest passed, and Playwright passed with two GPU-dependent tests skipped.
